observations: Raised asymmetric left gabled facade, white projecting piers, paired geometric lattice panels and recessed lower panel remain distinctive.
Low right wing retains yellow fascia, narrow reddish door and open central entrance; sign is small in overview but station board is legible in platform view.
Two dated facade/ramp references are treated as historical, not a present-day survey. Exact dimensions, unseen furnishings and approach are reconstructions.
Current03 clearly shows both tracks, side platforms, station board, compact shelter and furnishings; previous board obstruction resolved.
Ticket interior is modest and functional, without duplicate counters or an invented large concourse.
Current02/04 were inspected again because their hashes changed. No prior pixel verdict was blindly retained.
limitations: No independent geometry or clearance certification in this review.
Stylized materials and vegetation are acceptable; exact paint/weathering and photographic realism are not required.
Contact sheet must not be treated as authoritative for current image contents.
